# Pragmatic Sysadmin
> Pragmatic sysadmin guides, server troubleshooting checklists, senior tech family support, and free interactive browser tools by Jonne, a Finnish systems administrator.

## Detailed Free Tools Index
### Command Simulator
URL: https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/command-simulator.html
Summary: Simulate and practice dangerous Linux and Windows commands (rm -rf, dd, chmod) safely in-browser.

### AI Prompt Builder for Sysadmins
URL: https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/ai-prompt-builder.html
Summary: Generate precision prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot tailored to bash scripts and cloud infra.

### CLI Adventure
URL: https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/cli-adventure.html
Summary: Gamified terminal simulation solving realistic production IT incidents.

### Password Strength Checker
URL: https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/password-checker.html
Summary: Client-side password security analysis with entropy calculation and zero data transmission.

### Pragmatic Pulse Resilience Scorecard
URL: https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/pulse.html
Summary: Digital resilience audit assessing backups, credential hygiene, and disaster recovery readiness.

### PowerShell & Bash Script Generator
URL: https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/script-generator.html
Summary: Interactive generator for production-ready administrative scripts across Linux and Windows.

### Homelab Architect & Spec Calculator
URL: https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/homelab-architect.html
Summary: Interactive sizing calculator for self-hosted home labs: CPU cores, RAM allocation, and storage.

### Battle Station Score
URL: https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/battle-station-score.html
Summary: Interactive ergonomics, peripherals, and desk setup rater providing custom upgrade tips.

### Tech Needs Advisor
URL: https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/tech-needs-advisor.html
Summary: Decision tree recommending hardware and software configurations for students and pros.

### Corporate Translator & Incident Report Generator
URL: https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/corporate-translator.html
Summary: Convert plain-English postmortems and IT outages into formal corporate status communications.

### Plain English Tech Explainer
URL: https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/plain-english.html
Summary: Translate cryptic system errors and log stacktraces into understandable non-technical language.

### PRISM Architecture Simulator
URL: https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/prism-engine.html
Summary: Interactive simulation playground for distributed systems failure modes and failover.
